title.zh: 查询号码的发送量指标
title.en: Query phone number sending volume metrics

descriptions.zh:
- 此接口只能查询WhatsApp类型通道的号码发送量统计指标。

- 您可调用此接口查询号码发送量指标，也可在<props="china">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>**管理**>**客户统计日报**界面查询号码发送量指标。


- 在调用此接口前，请先调用[EnableWhatsAppROIMetric](~~2557789~~)接口开启WhatsApp ROI指标统计，开启后至少需一天才会有统计数据，开启前的消息发送量指标将不进行统计。

- 开启WhatsApp ROI指标统计后，请确保您创建的通道已有成功发送的消息。您可在<props="china">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>**管理**>**消息发送**界面发送消息，或通过[SendChatappMessage](~~432208~~)、[SendChatappMassMessage](~~447926~~)接口发送消息。


### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- This operation can only query the sending volume metrics for phone numbers on WhatsApp channels.

- You can call this operation to query phone number sending volume metrics, or view them in the <props="china">[**Channels Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**Channels Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Manage** > **Customer Statistics Daily Report** page.


- Before calling this operation, call the [EnableWhatsAppROIMetric](~~2557789~~) operation to enable WhatsApp ROI metric collection. After enabling, at least one day is required before statistics become available. Message sending volume metrics for messages sent before enabling are not collected.

- After enabling WhatsApp ROI metric collection, ensure that your channel has successfully sent messages. You can send messages on the <props="china">[**Channels Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**Channels Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Manage** > **Send Message** page, or by calling the [SendChatappMessage](~~432208~~) or [SendChatappMassMessage](~~447926~~) operation.


### QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 50 calls per second. Requests that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as appropriate.
